comments: NMR-coupled triaxial testing enables quantitative decoupling of geometric and mechanical damage mechanisms during ice-water transitions.

model_io.model: Fractional-order creep model with microscopic damage parameter

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phase transition damage can be decoupled from mechanical damage using unfrozen water content as state variable
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; microscopic-to-macroscopic cascading mechanism validated with >90% model-experiment agreement

title: Respiratory-inspired electrostatic open-microfluidics for air purification
task: Biomimetic air purification using electrostatic open-microfluidics inspired by respiratory epithelium
key_results: EOM system captures particulates at gas-liquid interface enhanced by electric field; polarized gaseous pollutants removed by free radicals and custom liquids; herringbone channels improve air-liquid interaction
comments: Open-microfluidic design with dynamically refreshed interfaces mimics mucus-cilia function for scalable air treatment.

model_io.model: Electrostatic open-microfluidics (EOM) system with gas-liquid interface

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electrostatic field enhances particulate capture at gas-liquid interface relative to passive microfluidics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; field-assisted polarization and deflection improve purification efficiency

title: Radioactive molecules as laboratories of fundamental physics
task: Exploring fundamental physics using radioactive molecules as probes
key_results: Radioactive molecules provide complementary energy scale sensitivity to particle colliders; progress in production and control enables beyond-standard-model physics searches
comments: Perspective paper identifying an emerging interdisciplinary platform combining nuclear, atomic, and particle physics sensitivities.

title: Autonomous navigation of intelligent microrobotic swarms in unknown environments
task: Reinforcement learning-based autonomous swarm navigation in unknown environments with sim-to-real transfer
key_results: RL policy enables obstacle avoidance, cargo transport, moving target tracking, and recovery from vision loss; multi-level domain randomization (environment, perception, actuation, dynamics) bridges simulation-reality gap
comments: Temporally extended attention mechanism allows swarm to make task-priority decisions using partial sensory input and historical context.

model_io.model: RL-trained swarm controller with magnetic actuation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Simulation-trained policy transfers to real swarms in unknown environments with multi-level domain randomization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; swarm achieves autonomous navigation and dynamic obstacle avoidance

title: Laser plasma sound sources as thermally driven pulsating spheres
task: Modeling laser-plasma acoustic sources as thermally driven pulsating spheres
key_results: Time-resolved shadowgraphy validates pulsating sphere model when source radius is defined at nonlinear-to-linear transition boundary; effective sound speed averaged over wavefront evolution reproduces dominant spectral features
comments: Phenomenological mapping enables rapid acoustic emission prediction for laser-breakdown sources under studied conditions.

model_io.model: Nanosecond laser breakdown in ambient air modeled as pulsating sphere

hypotheses.hypothesis: Laser-plasma acoustic emission follows classical pulsating sphere theory
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mapping validated via time-resolved shadowgraphy with appropriate source radius definition

title: Structural and optical evolution of SrTi(OxS1−x)3 oxysulfide perovskites via controlled sulfur incorporation
task: Engineering band gap in mixed-anion SrTi(OxS₁₋ₓ)₃ oxysulfide perovskites via controlled sulfur incorporation
key_results: Sulfur incorporation narrows band gap from 1.59 eV (SrTiO₃) to 1.45 eV (sulfur-rich film); polymorphic coexistence of pseudocubic and hexagonal phases; Urbach energy 67 meV indicates moderate disorder
comments: Composition-structure-optical correlation demonstrates effective band gap tuning for visible-light absorption in sustainable perovskites.

model_io.model: SrTi(OxS₁₋ₓ)₃ oxysulfide perovskite synthesis and characterization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sulfur substitution induces lattice distortion with reduced band gap
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; band gap narrowing to 1.45 eV with microstrain evidence but no complete phase transformation

title: Probing the limits of genetic recoding using multi-omics-guided evolution
task: Optimize radical genetic code reassignment using multi-omics-guided evolution
key_results: Successfully constructed E. coli strains with up to 45.8% recoded genome using 57-codon genetic code; multi-omics-guided evolution restored fitness despite widespread transcriptional, translational, and proteomic defects
comments: Powerful demonstration of using systems-level data to debug synthetic genomes, though fitness restoration metrics and condition breadth could be quantified more precisely.

model_io.model: Multi-omics guided synthetic genome design and evolution
inputs: Selection pressures across hundreds of growth conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Genetic code recoding induces compensatory transcriptional and translational changes
hypotheses.result: Multi-omics profiling reveals widespread transcriptional and translational defects under hundreds of conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-omics data can guide iterative genome design to mitigate recoding defects
hypotheses.result: Revised genome design and evolution strategy rapidly restores fitness in recoded strains

title: Allostery is a widespread cause of loss-of-function variant pathogenicity
task: Characterize allostery as a widespread mechanism of loss-of-function variant pathogenicity
key_results: Allostery accounts for a significant fraction of loss-of-function pathogenic variants independent of protein destabilization; allosteric effects decay distance-dependently from active sites
comments: Elegant framework separating stability from activity effects, but prediction across the full proteome remains challenging and the mechanistic basis of allosteric pathogenicity needs further exploration.

model_io.model: Comparative allosteric framework

hypotheses.hypothesis: Allostery is a widespread cause of loss-of-function variant pathogenicity
hypotheses.result: Comparative analysis across diverse datasets confirms allostery as independent mechanism from protein destabilization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Allosteric effects decay with distance from active sites
hypotheses.result: Conservation of distance-dependent decay pattern observed across proteome

title: Vitiligo Information Resource database v3
task: Integrative database for vitiligo molecular mechanisms and drug discovery
key_results: VIRdb v3.0 integrates transcriptomics, protein-protein interaction networks, and compound libraries; enables pathway enrichment and cross-disease comparisons with other autoimmune disorders
comments: Curated database approach is valuable for hypothesis generation but relies on existing literature; actual mechanistic insights into vitiligo pathogenesis would require experimental validation beyond the database itself.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vitiligo shares molecular signatures with other autoimmune disorders
